verdict.rationale: Skills can bundle scripts that process multiple items (e.g., the PDF skill 'merges multiple PDFs', and skills can include arbitrary bash/python scripts for batch tasks), showing the mechanism could support bulk operations, but there is no dedicated bulk-operation feature, no documentation of processing large item sets, and community reports note skills are often not reliably invoked. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch processing documentation, evidence of scale (many items processed reliably), and confirmation that triggering works consistently for bulk workflows rather than single tasks.
